item.title: Mozart Block at Nine O’Clock
item.description: The Mozart Block at 9 O’Clock jump-starts your workdays every weekday morning at 9:00 AM. The world’s most renowned composer and child superstar, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, and his music continue to delight, in this program filled with his beloved music.

item.title: Dinner Classics
item.description: After a busy day, Monday-Friday, Dinner Classics offers you a way to relax and unwind from 6:00 to 8:00 PM. This program is the perfect accompaniment with the evening meal, a favorite book or while surfing the web. Take time for yourself with some of these classical favorites!

item.title: All-Time Classics
item.description: All-Time Classics: Each evening from 9-10 PM, you can relax as you enjoy All Time Classics. This program showcases the performances of composers, conductors and orchestras of which you just can’t seem to get enough.

item.title: Sunday Brunch
item.description: On Sundays, from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM, tune in and leave it on throughout the day for our Sunday Brunch. This program offers you a time to relax and get away from weekday stresses and distractions. The work week is upon you so enjoy the calm before the storm with these classical masterpieces.
